gifts.name: Mystery Gift
gifts.source: Super Spooktacular's Mystery Gift (2013), fanbyte Category:Super_Spooktacular, 2013 quest series (lab/references/fanbyte-events-20261111/super_spooktacular.html): 'can be anything from candy to a nifty costume'. 12 costumes (Bixie, Changeling Ninja, Chatty, Chugawug, Darkthorne, Floren, Man-Eating Plant, Robgoblin, Shambler, Tree Soldier, Valerian, Yeti), 12 face paint cards (Bandit, Flower, Gothic Rag Doll, Kitty, Phantom, Saber-toothed, Sea Monster, Starry Moons, The Monster, Tiger, Troll, Witch; each a boys' or girls' row in the item table) and 5 candies (Pumpkin, Skeleton, Tarantula, Widow, Wraith). Item 9099 is the client's 'Mystery Gift' (type 6, icon 6412; 9100-9111 are copies of it and quests pay the lowest). (R) Phantom and Troll Face Paint Card have two rows each; the lowest id is used. (R) Equal odds.
